description: Resolve an EU legal citation — a CELEX number, ELI URI, ECLI, an OJ citation naming its act type and year (e.g. "Regulation (EU) 2016/679", "Directive 95/46/EC"), an Official Journal reference naming its issue, date, and first page (e.g. "OJ L 119, 4.5.2016, p. 1"), a Commission document number (e.g. "COM(2021) 206 final", also SEC, SWD, JOIN), or an interinstitutional procedure reference (e.g. "2021/0106(COD)", resolved to the act that initiated it) — to its canonical CELLAR work, confirming it exists before you fetch or traverse it. Returns the work URI, confirmed CELEX number, document type, date, and the ECLI of a case that carries one. A CELEX that CELLAR holds under several works resolves to the one the EUR-Lex content resolver serves. An ECLI shared by several records (a judgment and its abstract or extract, or a joined AG opinion) resolves to the primary record with the lowest CELEX. An OJ reference whose first page starts several acts, a document number CELLAR holds in several parts, and a procedure with several initiating acts return found false, the notice naming each CELEX.

identifier.description: The EU legal citation to resolve: a CELEX number (e.g. 32016R0679), a work-level ELI URI (e.g. http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679, with or without the /oj suffix), an ECLI (e.g. ECLI:EU:C:2014:317), or an OJ citation that names its act type and year, resolved to the CELEX it names under identifier_type "auto": Regulation (EU) 2016/679, Regulation (EC) No 1049/2001, Directive 95/46/EC, Decision No 1313/2013/EU, Council Framework Decision 2002/584/JHA, Council Joint Action 2008/124/CFSP, Common Position 2003/444/CFSP. "No" before the numbers means number/year, otherwise year/number; a two-digit year is 19YY. A citation without its act type (95/46/EC) or year (Regulation No 17) is not parsed; one followed by its parenthesized OJ reference (Directive 95/46/EC (OJ L 281, 23.11.1995, p. 31)) or by the period closing a sentence resolves as the citation. An Official Journal reference resolves, also under "auto", to the act starting on the page it cites: OJ L 281, 23.11.1995, p. 31 (also "of 23.11.1995", a page range, a class letter as in OJ L 42I, OJ C, and before 1968 the series-less OJ 13, 21.2.1962, p. 204/62), the year-first OJ 1995 L 281, p. 31 or [1995] OJ L281/31, and the act-by-act OJ L, 2024/1689, 12.7.2024 or OJ C, C/2024/2664, 29.4.2024; the spellings OJ No L 281, O.J. L 281, a spaced date (23. 11. 1995), pp. 1-88, and OJ L 2024/1689 without its comma are read too, and the cited date must be the publication date. A reference without its year or first page (OJ L 281, OJ L 119/1) is not parsed. A Commission document number resolves, also under "auto", to the work carrying it: COM(2021) 206 final, also COM(2021)206, COM/2021/206, or COM (2021) 0206, final/2 for its second version, a two-digit year read as 19YY (COM(90) 314 final), and SEC, SWD, and JOIN numbers; a Commission decision number (C(2021) 4500 final) is not read. An interinstitutional procedure reference resolves to the act that initiated the procedure: 2021/0106(COD), also 2021/106 (COD) or 2021/0106/COD; one without its type (2021/0106) is not read. A CELEX is also read in lowercase, after a CELEX: prefix, from a EUR-Lex page URL carrying uri=CELEX:… (e.g. https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:32016R0679), or from a publications.europa.eu/resource/celex/ URI; an ELI over https, on the eur-lex.europa.eu host, without a scheme, with a trailing slash, or with a language segment after /oj or a date (…/oj/eng). A case number (C-131/12) names several records rather than one work and returns found false with a pointer to eurlex_get_cases.

identifier_type.description: Format of the identifier. "auto" detects a CELEX, an ELI URI, an ECLI (by its ECLI: prefix, in any letter case), an OJ citation, an Official Journal reference, a Commission document number, or a procedure reference; "celex", "eli", or "ecli" forces that lookup. An OJ citation or reference, a Commission document number, and a procedure reference are recognized only under "auto".

name: eurlex_lookup_celex

celex_number.description: Confirmed CELEX number for the resolved work.

date.description: Document date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Absent when CELLAR records no real document date — none, or the 1001-01-01 it records for an undated work.

ecli.description: European Case Law Identifier of the case (e.g. "ECLI:EU:C:2014:317"), as CELLAR stores it — the resolved work's own, or the one another work holding the same CELEX records. Present for case law that carries one; absent for legislation and judicial notices.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `ambiguous_identifier`: identifier_type is "auto" and the identifier, after trimming, is neither an ECLI (ECLI: prefix), an ELI, a CELEX (bare, after a CELEX: prefix, or in a EUR-Lex URL), a prefixed case number, an OJ citation naming its act type and year (e.g. "Regulation No 17" names no year), an Official Journal reference naming its issue, year, and first page (e.g. "OJ L 281" names neither), a Commission document number (COM, SEC, SWD, or JOIN with its year and number; "C(2021) 4500 final" is none), nor a procedure reference with its type (e.g. "2021/0106(COD)"), so no lookup branch applies. `sparql_error`: CELLAR rejected the lookup query this call sent. The same call fails the same way again. `sparql_timeout`: The lookup ran past its time budget (retryable: CELLAR's response time varies, so a later lookup can finish), or CELLAR refused a lookup query as too costly to run (not retryable: the same query is refused again). Neither is retried within the call. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

found.description: True when the identifier resolves to a CELLAR work; false when a well-formed CELEX, ELI, ECLI, OJ citation, Official Journal reference, Commission document number, or procedure reference matches no work in the corpus, when an OJ reference's first page starts several acts, when a document number or procedure names several works, when a procedure has no initiating act with a CELEX, or when the identifier is a case number, with a notice naming what was tried. Only an identifier_type "auto" value that, after trimming, is neither an ECLI, an ELI, a CELEX in any accepted form, an OJ citation naming its act type and year, an OJ reference naming its issue, year, and first page, a Commission document number, nor a procedure reference with its type raises ambiguous_identifier instead.

notice.description: Present only when found is false: the CELEX, ELI, ECLI, OJ reference, Commission document number, or procedure looked up, the accepted forms, and the search to use instead; for an OJ reference whose first page starts several acts, or a document number or procedure naming several works, the CELEX of each.

resource_type.description: Human-readable document category resolved from the CDM resource type (e.g. "Regulation", "Directive", "Judgment"). An authority value with no known label falls back to its code (e.g. "BUDGET"). Absent for some works.

title: Resolve EU Legal Citation
